title: La Mora - instrumental interlude and text pickup
source_location: York University John Arpin collection JAC009399, printed and PDF p. 4, system 3 after the double bar, system 4, and the first bar of system 5.
scope: Seven instrumental bars and the one-bar pickup before the texted repeat. Starts after OTRA 2ª and stops at the repeat start.
editorial: The upper C4 ties across bars 1–2 and 5–6. There is a fresh C4 at the start of system 4, even though the preceding system ends on C4.
The last two upper sixteenths of bar 2 are both E4. The first system of the closing refrain on p. 5 instead ends the corresponding bar on C4.
The lower staff has both C2 and E2 on the final eighth of bar 6. The analogous closing-refrain bar has C2 alone.
The pickup uses the four printed upper chords and the one lower octave. The repeat that follows it is outside the excerpt.
Quarter-note tempo 96 and fixed velocity are editorial. The hairpins, accent marks and phrasing slurs do not change MIDI note lengths.
